secrets.name: CHECK_ET_API_KEY
secrets.description: Check.et API key for Telebirr deposit verification. Optional — the deposit feature returns 'not configured' without it. Obtain from the Check.et dashboard.

secrets.name: TELEBIRR_ACCOUNT
secrets.description: Telebirr account number (phone) used to match deposit receipts. Optional.

secrets.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Telegram bot token for sending deposit notifications. Optional.

secrets.name: TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
secrets.description: Telegram chat ID for notifications. Optional — auto-detected from bot updates if omitted.
